# SpikeRateEncoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of representing information as the frequency of spikes over a time window in a spiking neural network. Provides a robust and biologically plausible encoding scheme for visual data, compatible with low-power neuromorphic processors in iNEST.
